claim: Aligned with ICD 203, 206 and 208 principles. The directives bind Intelligence Community elements only; this suite is not one, so it never claims compliance.
verified: Checked 30 Oct 2026: the operative text is the 2 Jan 2015 directive. The 12 Jun 2023 technical amendment adds annual analyst training only; the likelihood table and the standards are unchanged.
analytic_standards: Based on all available sources of intelligence information
Implements and exhibits the analytic tradecraft standards

tradecraft_standards.title: Properly describes quality and credibility of underlying sources, data, and methodologies
tradecraft_standards.checks: sources[] with publisher, licence, access time and descriptor; method_version; coverage_fraction

tradecraft_standards.title: Properly expresses and explains uncertainties associated with major analytic judgments
tradecraft_standards.checks: judgments carry probability, its ICD 203 term, confidence and confidence_basis; anomalies carry baseline_ref

tradecraft_standards.title: Properly distinguishes between underlying intelligence information and analysts' assumptions and judgments
tradecraft_standards.checks: kind and tier are consistent (observation versus judgment); status_class set

tradecraft_standards.title: Incorporates analysis of alternatives
tradecraft_standards.checks: judgments list alternatives[], each with the indicator that would tell it apart

tradecraft_standards.title: Demonstrates customer relevance and addresses implications
tradecraft_standards.checks: requirement_ids[] or warning_problem_id link the item to a written requirement

tradecraft_standards.title: Uses clear and logical argumentation
tradecraft_standards.checks: title, and a summary for judgments; indicator links complete (hypothesis, direction, state)

tradecraft_standards.title: Explains change to or consistency of analytic judgments
tradecraft_standards.checks: change_from_prior, and change_reason when it changed; supersedes for updates and cancels

tradecraft_standards.title: Makes accurate judgments and assessments
tradecraft_standards.checks: forecasts carry a resolution rule and valid_until so Verdict can score them

tradecraft_standards.title: Incorporates effective visual information where appropriate
tradecraft_standards.checks: every item has a geometry or a visual (the suite's visual-first rule)

no_mixing_rule: ICD 203 D.6.e(2)(b): products must not combine a confidence level and a degree of likelihood in one sentence.

sourcing.standard: ICS 206-01, Citation and Reference for Publicly Available Information, Commercially Available Information, and Open Source Intelligence (2 Dec 2024; supersedes 26 Sep 2017)
sourcing.icd206_amendment: 18 Dec 2025: PAI, CAI and OSINT are sourced per ICS 206-01
fields: publication date (or access date when the posting date is unknown)
source descriptor (credibility, bias, quality, reliability, validity, evaluated or not, collector, tool or database used, third-party provenance)
sourcing.retention: Keep a record of a dynamic web source for at least one year.
sourcing.note: Classification fields do not apply: the suite publishes public information only and never uses markings.
